pages.text: Day 96. The $(item)Particle Spectrometer$() splits quark-gluon plasma into $(item)quark flavours$(), $(item)leptons$() and $(item)gauge bosons$(). The heaviest quarks and the $(item)Higgs$() need the Synchrotron.

The $(thing)Standard Model$() is our best account of matter: six quarks, six leptons, the gauge bosons that carry the forces, and the Higgs, whose field gives particles their mass. It is astonishingly accurate, and plainly incomplete - it has no gravity and no dark matter.

All of them together make the $(item)Standard Model Matrix$(). The Collider turns it and dark matter into $(item)Superpartner Shards$(), and the Tesseract Assembler unifies everything into a $(item)Grand Unified Core$().$(br2)Correction to my earlier notes: the Higgs Catalyst now needs a real Higgs boson.
Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.$(br2)Made in $(item)Femtoscale Assembly Line$().
An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.$(br2)Made in $(item)Hyperion Synchrotron$().
At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.$(br2)Made in $(item)Tesseract Assembler$().
A neutralino: the supersymmetric twin of a boson. It turns out to be what dark matter is made of.$(br2)Made in $(item)Quark-Gluon Collider$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Standard Model Matrix$(): Dark Matter, Dimensional Residue, Grand Unified Core, Standard Model Singularity, Superpartner Shard$(li)$(item)Higgs Boson Crystal$(): Higgs Catalyst, Standard Model Matrix, Standard Model Singularity$(li)$(item)Grand Unified Core$(): Dimensional Residue, Eschaton Core, Standard Model Singularity, Theory of Everything, Transcendent Metal Ingot and more$...
